1. (Currently amended) An ultrasonic surgical instrument assembly comprising: a handpiece; a transducer or generator of ultrasonic mechanical vibrations disposed in said handpiece; a probe attached to a distal end of said handpiece and operatively connected to said transducer or generator; and a light source attached to said handpiece so as to direct at least visible electromagnetic radiation along the probe towards a surgical site distal of the probe, __said light source being removably attached to said handpiece by a fastener__.

2. (Currently amended) The surgical instrument assembly defined in claim 1, further comprising a power supply mounted at least indirectly to said handpiece and operatively connected to said light source, __said power supply being separate from said transducer or generator__.

5. (Previously presented) The surgical instrument assembly defined in claim 2, further comprising a fastener for removably attaching said light source to said handpiece.

6. (Previously presented) The surgical instrument assembly defined in claim 5, further comprising at least one additional fastener for removably attaching said power supply at least indirectly to said handpiece.

7. (Previously presented) The surgical instrument assembly defined in claim 2 wherein said power supply is a battery.

10. (Currently amended) The surgical instrument assembly defined in claim 1 wherein said light source is attached to a distal end of said handpiece __by a fastener__ and is oriented to provide illumination along said probe to the surgical site.

11. (Currently amended) An accessory for a surgical instrument comprising a handpiece, a transducer or generator of ultrasonic mechanical vibrations disposed in said handpiece, and a probe attached to a distal end of said handpiece and operatively connected to said transducer or generator, said accessory comprising: a light source; a fastener for removably attaching said light source to said handpiece; and at least one power supply component operatively connectable to said light source, __said at least one power supply component being separate from said transducer or generator__.

12. (Currently amended) The accessory defined in claim 11 wherein said power supply component includes a coil __configured to be disposed__ about a power cable feeding said transducer or generator, further comprising an additional fastener for removably attaching __said power supply component so that said coil is disposed__ about the power cable.

14. (Previously presented) The accessory defined in claim 11 wherein said power supply component includes a battery.

17. (Currently amended) The accessory defined in claim 11 wherein said fastener is configured for attaching said light source to a distal end of said handpiece __by removable attachment__ and for orienting said light source to provide illumination along said probe to a surgical site.

19. (Currently amended) A surgical method comprising: providing a surgical instrument having a handpiece, a transducer or generator of ultrasonic mechanical vibrations disposed in said handpiece and a probe attached to a distal end of said handpiece and operatively connected to said transducer or generator; providing a light source; applying a fastener to said handpiece to attach said light source thereto so that light from said light source is directable [[generally]] __substantially__ parallel to said probe; operating said surgical instrument to apply ultrasonic vibratory energy to a surgical site; during the operating of said surgical instrument, conducting electrical energy from a power supply to said light source; and during the operating of said surgical instrument and the conducting of said electrical energy, illuminating said surgical site with light from said source.

20. (Previously presented) The surgical method defined in claim 19 further comprising removably mounting said power supply at least indirectly to said handpiece.

21. (Currently amended) The surgical method defined in claim 20 wherein said power supply includes a coil, the removable mounting of said power supply at least indirectly to said handpiece including disposing said coil about a power cable feeding said transducer or generator __and removably fastening said power supply so that said coil is disposed about said power cable__.

25. (Currently amended) An accessory for a medical instrument comprising a handpiece and a probe or tool extension on a distal end of said handpiece, said accessory comprising: a light source; a fastener for removably attaching said light source to said instrument; and at least one power supply component operatively connectable to said light source, said power supply component including a coil __configured to be disposed__ about a power cable extending to said handpiece, further comprising an additional fastener for removably attaching [[said coil about]] __said power supply component to position said coil about__ the power cable.
